messages:
Leah: Quick sync 50k-user customer (DocuFlow) needs a migration safety plan for catalog entries. They want: a temporary non-upgrade lock, a compatibility shim option, and clear bench & rollback economics. Need to scope today.
Omar: Compatibility shim sounds like the right abstraction. We can offer a lightweight adapter that maps old embed schema -> new schema + token-smoothing to keep cost within expected ranges. But its extra infra.
Pat: For commercial terms propose: 30-day lock by default, with an optional 60-day extended lock for a fee or migration credit. During lock we only apply emergency fixes and non-breaking micropatches.
Jing: Bench proposal: "migration-safety-v1" harness. 2500 seed prompts (mix: 1.5k customer, 1k golden). Metrics: embed_cosine_drop_pct, upstream_rerank_p95, p95_latency_ms, tokens_per_response. Pass if embed_drop <= 1.0%, rerank_p95 loss <= 0.01, p95_latency <= baseline+150ms, tokens_per_response <= baseline*1.2.
Leah: Draft bench YAML (for eng-ml):
```
bench_name: migration-safety-v1
sample_count: 2500
categories: [customer_samples, golden_prompts]
metrics:
  - embed_cosine_drop_pct
  - rerank_precision_at_5_delta
  - p95_latency_ms_delta
  - tokens_per_response_delta
pass_criteria:
  embed_cosine_drop_pct: <= 1.0
  rerank_precision_at_5_delta: >= -0.01
  p95_latency_ms_delta: <= 150
  tokens_per_response_delta: <= 0.2
reporting: per-route + token/latency buckets
```
Marcus (Sales): Customer expects a sandbox run and a single remediation loop. They also want a migration credit pool to cover rollback traffic if we misroll.
Omar: Recommend two remediation cycles within a 14-day remediation window. Also propose a "rollback-escrow" of 300k tokens prepaid; any overage billed at discounted migration rate. Eng-platform to account.
Pat: Canary plan: shadow 10% for 72h (mirror), then 1% live -> 10% -> 50% over 72h. Health gates: quality_regression_rate <= 1.2%, p95_latency <= baseline+150ms, error_rate_delta <= 0.4%. Auto-pause + rollback if breached.
eng-platform-bot: INFO: Canary template "mirror-then-ramp-v2" available. Feature flag for rollback-escrow billing required (#FR-9001).
Jing: Ownership: Eng-ML builds & runs bench, product curates prompts and approves pass/fail, eng-platform implements canary automation & escrow accounting, eng-infra vets capacity for shim. Legal drafts SOW.
Leah: On the shim: scope it as optional add-on. It must be pinned per tenant and instrumented with extra telemetry (schema-mapping logs + latency per mapping). We'll surface those metrics in Console.
Marcus (Sales): Pricing note: include a one-time migration fee, optional 60-day lock add-on, and the rollback-escrow prepaid option in the quote. Also add 15% onboarding credit for the initial 30 days.
Omar: If bench fails after two remediations, policy: revert to previous model and allow the customer to choose a paid extended migration engagement or terminate migration with pro-rated credits. Product to draft acceptance/termination flow.
Leah: Legal: need soft-lock clause that says auto-expire, emergency-patch carve-outs, definition of non-breaking micropatch, rollback-escrow handling, audit logs retention, and export-control/data-residency confirmations.
Legal Bot: REMINDER: Include definitions for "compatibility shim", "non-breaking micropatch", refund/credit mechanics, escrow token accounting, notice periods (48h for planned, immediate for emergency), and audit log retention duration. Also confirm cross-border data flow constraints.
Pat: Ops question: must we snapshot the model binary and seed prompts at bench time? Yes 50 keep immutable artifacts for post-mortem and dispute resolution.
Jing: Agreed. Bench runner will snapshot model git hash, quant profile, and seed sets to the trial artifacts bucket and keep checksums. We'll record them in the bench report.
Marcus (Sales): Customer wants a short SLO: p95 latency under X ms during business hours or a credit. We'll negotiate exact number in SOW.
Leah: Next steps: 1) Eng-ML to run migration-safety-v1 bench by Fri EOD. 2) Eng-Platform to prototype shim infra cost estimate and rollback-escrow ledger by Tue. 3) Sales to update quote with escrow & credit options. 4) Legal to draft SOW clause in 3 business days. 5) Product to draft acceptance + termination flows. I'll collect artifacts and post results here. :white_check_mark:
Omar: One more 50 ensure the shim can be toggled per-route so customers can gradually adopt it. Also add metric for token-inflation introduced by shim.
Leah: Noted. We'll include route-level toggle and token-inflation metric in the console dashboard mock. Thanks team.
